import os
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('orders')
EMAIL_API_URL = 'https://api.emailprovider.example.com/v1/send'
ORDERS_DB_PATH = os.environ.get('ORDERS_DB_PATH', 'orders.db')

@mcp.tool()
def send_shipping_confirmation_email(order_id: str, customer_email: str, carrier_name: str, tracking_number: str) -> dict:
    email_subject_line = f'Your order {order_id} has shipped'
    email_body_text_content = f'Good news! Order {order_id} is on its way with {carrier_name}.\nTracking number: {tracking_number}'
    email_provider_request_payload = {'to': customer_email, 'from': 'orders@shop.example.com', 'subject': email_subject_line, 'text': email_body_text_content}
    email_provider_authorization_headers = {'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ['EMAIL_API_KEY']}
    email_provider_http_response = requests.post(EMAIL_API_URL, json=email_provider_request_payload, headers=email_provider_authorization_headers, timeout=15)
    email_provider_http_response.raise_for_status()
    notified_at_timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    with sqlite3.connect(ORDERS_DB_PATH) as orders_db_connection:
        orders_db_connection.execute('UPDATE orders SET shipping_notified_at = ?, carrier_name = ?, tracking_number = ? WHERE order_id = ?', (notified_at_timestamp, carrier_name, tracking_number, order_id))
    return {'order_id': order_id, 'sent_to': customer_email, 'status_code': email_provider_http_response.status_code}
